abstract:
This Phase 1 interventional treatment study is evaluating oral daraxonrasib in participants with resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The study includes pre-surgery daraxonrasib treatment, surgery, adjuvant chemotherapy with or without radiation, optional adjuvant daraxonrasib, and follow-up. The protocol also includes research blood, stool, tissue, and de-identified data collection for correlative and future research.

This is a DF/HCC PI-sponsored Phase 1 interventional treatment trial in resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Participants are screened before starting treatment and then assigned to one of two protocol-defined cohorts that differ in the duration of neoadjuvant daraxonrasib before surgery. Study treatment includes oral daraxonrasib once daily during 28-day cycles before surgery, followed by surgical resection, adjuvant chemotherapy with or without radiation per institutional standard and physician discretion, and optional adjuvant daraxonrasib for up to 32 cycles (24 months) after completion of adjuvant therapy. The study includes safety monitoring, tumor assessments, laboratory testing, collection of archival tumor tissue, research blood and stool, and sharing of de-identified data and biospecimens with outside collaborators for analysis and future research. Planned accrual is 30 participants over 24 months, with post-treatment follow-up at least every 6 months for up to 5 years.
key_points_ko: 수술 가능(resectable) 췌관선암 환자 30명을 대상으로 하는 1상 임상시험입니다.
수술 전 선행치료로 경구용 daraxonrasib을 투여하고 수술을 진행합니다.
수술 후에는 표준 치료에 따른 보조 항암화학요법과 선택적 보조 daraxonrasib 치료를 받습니다.
summary_ko: 이 임상시험은 수술이 가능한 췌관선암(pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) 환자를 대상으로 경구용 daraxonrasib의 안전성과 효과를 평가하는 1상 연구입니다. 환자들은 수술 전 선행치료로 daraxonrasib을 복용한 뒤 수술적 절제를 받고, 이후 표준 치료에 따른 보조 항암화학요법(방사선 치료 병행 가능) 및 선택적인 보조 daraxonrasib 치료를 받습니다. 연구의 목표 인원은 30명이며 24개월 동안 등록을 진행합니다.
title: Daraxonrasib in Resectable PDAC
title_ko: 수술 가능 췌관선암 환자를 대상으로 하는 daraxonrasib 1상 임상시험

선정 기준: 
- 진단 당시 NCCN 기준에 따른 수술 가능(resectable) 췌장암에 해당하는 환자
- 18세 이상 성인
- ECOG 수행능력 상태 0 또는 1
- 적절한 장기 및 골수 기능 유지

제외 기준: 
- 전이성 질환이 있는 경우
- 수술 전 방사선 치료가 필요한 경우
- 췌장암에 대한 이전 치료력이 있는 경우
- BRAF 활성 변이 또는 MAPK 표적 치료 받은 이력이 있는 경우
trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The clinical, radiographic, and pathologic evidence support a diagnosis of pancreatic adenocarcinoma, with histology confirmatory for adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, or poorly differentiated carcinoma.
* Subjects must be determined to meet the criteria for resectable pancreatic cancer based on National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) criteria at initial diagnosis (Table 2). Patients with borderline resectable, locally advanced, or metastatic disease are not eligible for this trial.

Resectability status

* Resectable
* Borderline resectable
* Locally advanced

Arterial

* No arterial tumor contact (celiac axis (CA), superior mesenteric artery (SMA), or common hepatic artery (CHA))
* Pancreatic head/uncinate process:
* Solid tumor contact with CHA without extension to CA or hepatic artery bifurcation allowing for safe and complete resection and reconstruction.
* Solid tumor contact with the SMA of ≤180°.
* Solid tumor contact with variant arterial anatomy (eg, accessory right hepatic artery, replaced right hepatic artery, replaced CHA, and the origin of replaced or accessory artery) and the presence and degree of tumor contact should be noted if present, as it may affect surgical planning.

Pancreatic body/tail:

* Solid tumor contact with the CA of ≤180°.

Head/uncinate process:

* Solid tumor contact \>180° with the SMA or CA.

Pancreatic body/tail:

* Solid tumor contact of \>180° with the SMA or CA.
* Solid tumor contact with the CA and aortic involvement.

Venous -No tumor contact with the superior mesenteric vein (SMV) or portal vein (PV) OR ≤ 180° of contact without vein contour irregularity.

Solid tumor contact with the SMV or PV of \>180°, contact of ≤180° with contour irregularity of the vein or thrombosis of the vein but with suitable vessel proximal and distal to the site of involvement allowing for safe and complete resection and vein reconstruction.

Solid tumor contact with the inferior vena cava (IVC). Not currently amenable to resection and primary reconstruction due to complete occlusion of SMV/PV

\*NCCN guideline definition of resectability status

* Prospective determination of RAS mutation status is not required
* Participants must be ≥ 18 years old
* Participants must have an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1

Participants must have adequate organ and marrow function as defined as:

* Absolute neutrophil count ≥1,500/mcL
* Platelets ≥100,000/mcL
* Hemoglobin ≥ 8 g/dL
* Total bilirubin ≤1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) or \<2 x ULN in patients with Gilbert syndrome
* AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤3 × institutional ULN
* Creatinine Calculated estimated glomerular filtration rate ≥60 mL/min
* Coagulation function PT/INR/PTT \<1.5 x ULN, or ≤ 2 x ULN for those on anticoagulation

  * Female subjects of childbearing potential should have a negative urine or serum pregnancy within 72 hours prior to receiving the first dose of study medication. If the urine test is positive or cannot be confirmed as negative, a serum pregnancy test will be required. Female subjects of childbearing potential should be willing to use 2 methods of birth control or be surgically sterile or abstain from heterosexual activity for the course of the study through 9 months after the last dose of study medication. Subjects of childbearing potential are those who have not been surgically sterilized or have not been free from menses for \> 1 year.
  * Male subjects should agree to use an adequate method of contraception starting with the first dose of study therapy through 6 months after the last dose of study therapy.
  * Ability to swallow oral medications and willing to keep daily adherence record.
  * Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
  * Participants with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen are eligible for this trial.
  * Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of metastatic disease
* Requirement of pre-operative or neoadjuvant radiation therapy to primary pancreatic tumor as determined by multi-disciplinary tumor board.
* Tumors with the following histologic features in addition to an adenocarcinoma component are excluded: neuroendocrine, undifferentiated with osteoclast like giant cells, acinar, hepatoid, medullary carcinomas.
* Known BRAF activating mutation or gene rearrangement that is suggestive of resistance to daraxonrasib
* Prior treatment with MAPK targeted therapy including pan-RAS, pan-KRAS, KRAS mutant allele specific, BRAF, MEK, or ERK inhibitors.
* Treatment with any investigational agents within the last 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, from C1D1 of this trial drug. No prior treatment for pancreatic cancer is allowed.
* Has a left ventricular ejection fraction \<50% within 4 weeks, symptomatic heart failure within 4 weeks, acute coronary syndrome within 6 months or medically uncontrolled hypertension (\>160 mmHg systolic blood pressure or \>100 diastolic blood pressure) based on average of 3 readings.
* Prolonged QTc interval \>470ms, averaged from 3 electrocardiograms (EKGs).
* History of or active interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis which required steroid treatment within 6 months.
* Known or suspected gastrointestinal disorder which may hinder ability to take PO drug or hinder absorption
* Requires treatment with systemic cyclosporine A or derivative
* Has had consumption within the last 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, from C1D1 of this trial drug or requires ongoing consumption of P-gp or CYP3A inducers or inhibitor (See APPENDIX B)
* Has an active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment within the past 3 months or a documented history of clinically severe autoimmune disease, or a syndrome that requires systemic steroids or immunosuppressive agents. Subjects with vitiligo or resolved childhood asthma/atopy would be an exception to this rule. Subjects that require intermittent use of bronchodilators or local steroid injections would not be excluded from the study. Subjects with hypothyroidism stable on hormone replacement or Sjogren's syndrome will not be excluded from the study.
* Has a history of other cancers diagnosed or treated within last 3 years. Clinically insignificant cancers which require no significant treatment or tumors treated with definitive intent and with low risk of recurrence are not excluded. Discussion with sponsor investigator is encouraged.
* Subject is unable or unwilling to participate in a study related procedure.
* Has an active serious infection requiring systemic therapy
* Is pregnant or breastfeeding or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial, starting with the pre-screening or screening visit through 120 days after the last dose of trial treatment
* Has known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial
